title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.17523v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce and release ScienceBuddy, an interactive scientific research workspace that brings continually improving scientific agents into researchers' everyday workflows. ScienceBuddy supports researchers in carrying out scientific tasks while transforming their requests, feedback, and execution evidence into tasks and evaluation rubrics for continual learning. At its core is recursive-in-recursive self-improvement, a paradigm that couples harness evolution with model reinforcement learning: the inner recursion improves the harness with the model fixed, while the outer recursion trains the model under the improved harness. Harness evolution shapes training experience, and model learning creates new opportunities for harness adaptation. We present case studies of researcher interaction, harness refinement, and model learning, with the benchmark cases spanning four scientific task families. translated_title: ScienceBuddy：面向交互式科学智能体的递归嵌套自我改进
translated_abstract: 我们介绍并发布 ScienceBuddy，这是一个交互式科学研究工作区，将持续改进的科学智能体带入研究人员的日常工作流程。ScienceBuddy 支持研究人员执行科学任务，同时将他们的请求、反馈和执行证据转化为用于持续学习的任务和评估准则。其核心是递归嵌套自我改进（recursive-in-recursive self-improvement），这是一种将框架演化与模型强化学习相结合的范式：内层递归在模型固定的情况下改进框架，而外层递归在改进后的框架下训练模型。框架演化塑造训练经验，模型学习又为框架适应创造新的机会。我们展示了研究人员交互、框架细化和模型学习的案例研究，基准案例涵盖四个科学任务族。通过将 ScienceBuddy 作为研究产品发布……
tldr: ScienceBuddy 提出递归嵌套自我改进范式，通过框架演化与模型强化学习的双层递归耦合，构建了能够持续自我提升并融入研究人员日常工作流程的交互式科学智能体工作区。
en_tdlr: ScienceBuddy introduces a recursive-in-recursive self-improvement paradigm that couples harness evolution with model reinforcement learning, creating an interactive scientific workspace with continually improving agents for researchers' everyday workflows.
